description: This file defines an abstract class 'ext_rest' which extends a base class 'source'. It provides a template and some functionality for REST connectors, including URL handling and content fetching.

classes.name: ext_rest
classes.description: An abstract class for REST API connectors, providing methods to get and set the URL, and to fetch content from a URL.

methods.name: fetchUrl
methods.description: Fetches content from the specified URL using file_get_contents and logs an error if it fails.

methods.name: setUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL for the REST connector.
